# yAudit

> yAudit is a smart contract and zero-knowledge security firm offering audits, research, and tooling. Founded in 2021, yAudit has secured contracts holding billions in TVL and identified over 500 critical vulnerabilities.

yAudit specializes in securing DeFi protocols, ZK-powered networks, and cryptographic implementations. Core services include smart contract security audits, zero-knowledge (ZK) circuit audits, boosted audits, consulting, and training through fellowship programs. The team's expertise spans Solidity, Circom, Halo2, zkSTARKs, zkSNARKs, and related cryptographic primitives.

In 2024, yAudit expanded into ZK security research, supported by a grant from the Ethereum Foundation. The firm has run multiple zero-knowledge auditing fellowship cohorts in collaboration with the Privacy & Scaling Explorations (PSE) group at the Ethereum Foundation.

- [Services](https://yaudit.dev/services): Smart contract and ZK security audits, boosted audits, consulting, research, and training
- [ZK Security](https://yaudit.dev/zk): Zero-knowledge security services, research highlights, and team
- [Team](https://yaudit.dev/team): Core members, resident auditors, fellows, and alumni
- [Fellowships](https://yaudit.dev/fellowships): Smart contract and ZK security fellowship programs with hands-on audit experience
- [Contact Us](https://yaudit.dev/contact-us): Request a smart contract or ZK security audit

## Fellowship cohorts

- [zBlock 1](https://yaudit.dev/zBlock1): First zero-knowledge auditing fellowship (June 2023) — Circom, RLN, Spartan ECDSA
- [zBlock 2](https://yaudit.dev/zBlock2): Second zero-knowledge auditing fellowship (Jan–May 2024) — PSE-Halo2, KZG, Summa Protocol
